name: Code
description: Read-only code: a block with a header (file name, language and a copy button), optional line numbers and highlighted lines, or inline code in running text. No syntax highlighting. The block is a labeled scroll region that doesn't wrap; the header mirrors in RTL, the code stays LTR. For editable code, use CodeEditor.

livewire.name: code
capabilities: Rendered on the server; the copy button runs on the shared apuiClipboard Alpine component, reading the rendered lines back
The default slot holds the code when code is empty
2.x was an Ace editor bound with wire:model: use CodeEditor for that. Its label, hint, height, theme and print-margin props are gone

react.name: Code
capabilities: The copy button uses the behavior package's useClipboard, as Clipboard does

vue.name: Code
capabilities: The copy button uses the behavior package's useClipboard, as Clipboard does

props.name: code
props.description: The code. Split into lines on any line ending; one final line ending doesn't add an empty line. Shown as text, never as HTML.

props.name: language
props.description: The language, shown as a badge in the header, such as "TypeScript" or "Shell". Only a label: nothing is highlighted.

props.name: fileName
props.description: The file name or a title such as "Terminal", at the start of the header in the mono font.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Shows line numbers. They aren't part of the text, so selecting or copying the code leaves them out. Emitted as data-numbered.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Line numbers to emphasize (1-based), such as [3]. Each gets data-highlight: the selected fill and a primary bar. Highlight a few lines to make a point.

props.name: inline
props.description: Inline code in running text: a code element with no header, numbers or copy button. Emitted as data-inline.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows the copy button in the header. It copies the code and reads "Copied" for two seconds.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the scroll region. Defaults to the file name, then the language, then "Code" (Livewire through __( 'Code' )).
props.a11y: The region is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it, and needs a name. Name each block when a page has several with the same file name.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The copy button's label. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copy' ).

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: The copy button's label after a copy. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copied' ).

props.name: copiedMessage
props.description: Announced after a copy. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copied to clipboard' ).

props.name: errorMessage
props.default: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
props.description: Announced when the copy fails. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { header: '…', pre: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The frame, with data-numbered; or, inline, the code element with data-inline.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The file name, language and copy button. Mirrors in RTL. Left out when there is nothing to show.

parts.name: file
parts.description: The file name, in the mono font, cut with an ellipsis when long.

parts.name: language
parts.description: The language: a neutral outline Badge (sm).

parts.name: copy
parts.description: A ghost, neutral, xs Button with the copy icon and copyLabel, with data-state (idle, copied, failed). Reads copiedLabel with a check, in the success color, while copied.

parts.name: status
parts.description: A hidden role=status live region announcing copiedMessage or errorMessage.

parts.name: pre
parts.description: The code, always LTR (D-004): a focusable role=region named by label, scrolling instead of wrapping.

parts.name: line
parts.description: One line, with data-n (its number, drawn as a ::before when numbered) and data-highlight when emphasized.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The code as text, when code is empty (Livewire only: React and Vue take the code prop).

requirements: The block is a focusable role=region named by label, so keyboard users can scroll long lines.
Copying is announced in a live region (copiedMessage), and so is a failure (errorMessage); the button's label changes to Copied.
Line numbers aren't text: selecting and copying the code leaves them out.
The code stays LTR in every direction; the header mirrors.
Highlighted lines keep 4.5:1 for their text and numbers.
